Country Visions Is…
Agronomy
Full Service Agronomy Department with several locations throughout Eastern Wisconsin to serve the needs of our members and our communities.
Grain
With locations in Cedar Grove, Center Valley, Chilton, Kiel, Mishicot, Random Lake, Readfield, Valders and Whitelaw, we are ready to handle your grain needs!
Energy
We offer high-quality energy products provided by our dependable company which is dedicated to servicing our customers.
Country Stores
Your locally-owned, all-in-one destination for pet and small animal feed and supplies, as well as lawn, garden, and unique gift items.
C-Stores
Convenience you can rely on! From premium fuel to freshly brewed coffee and delicious snacks, we're here to fuel your day and your adventures—all in one convenient location.
